newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Burkina Faso reels from doctors' strike.
newsitem.headline: Burkina Faso reels from doctors' strike.

text.p: A strike by doctors and other health workers in Burkina Faso paralysed hospitals in the West African state on Saturday, with many patients left unattended in corridors, witnesses said.

Most emergency services were also shut by the 10-day strike, begun on Saturday on the orders of the National Health Workers Union. The union is demanding the reinstatement of 16 sacked public service members.
Partial stoppages started in the health services on June 17 after the 16 were fired and 150 others demoted for taking part in a previous strike.
More disruption loomed, with the umbrella Burkina Workers Confederation calling for general strikes on July 16 and 21 in solidarity with the health workers.
